name: Classic Pancakes
description: Fluffy pancakes with crisp edges and a soft center.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt.
Whisk milk, egg, and melted butter in a second bowl.
Combine wet and dry ingredients until just mixed; a few lumps are fine.
Heat a lightly buttered skillet over medium heat and pour about 1/4 cup batter per pancake.
Cook until bubbles form, flip, and cook until golden. Serve warm.

name: Avocado Egg Toast
description: Creamy avocado, a fried egg, and crisp toast.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Toast the bread until crisp.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Fry the eggs to your preferred doneness.
Spread avocado over toast and top with an egg.
Finish with black pepper and red pepper flakes.

name: Berry Yogurt Parfait
description: Layers of yogurt, berries, and crunchy granola.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Spoon half the yogurt into two glasses.
Add half the berries and granola.
Repeat the layers.
Drizzle with honey and serve chilled.

name: Breakfast Burrito
description: A warm tortilla packed with eggs, beans, cheese, and salsa.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet.
Scramble the eggs in oil and season with salt and pepper.
Warm the black beans.
Layer eggs, beans, cheese, and salsa down the center of each tortilla.
Fold in the sides, roll tightly, and toast seam-side down for 1 minute.

name: Banana Oatmeal
description: Creamy oats cooked with banana and cinnamon.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Bring milk or water and salt to a simmer.
Stir in oats and cook for 5 minutes.
Mash half the banana into the oats.
Top with the remaining banana, cinnamon, and honey.

name: Shakshuka
description: Eggs gently cooked in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Cook onion and pepper in olive oil until soft.
Add garlic, cumin, and paprika for 30 seconds.
Stir in tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes.
Make four wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook until the whites are set. Season and serve with bread.

name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
description: Grilled chicken, romaine, parmesan, and Caesar dressing in a soft wrap.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Warm the tortillas briefly.
Toss romaine with Caesar dressing and parmesan.
Place chicken down the center of each tortilla.
Add dressed lettuce and black pepper.
Fold the sides in and roll tightly.

name: Caprese Panini
description: Toasted bread with mozzarella, tomato, basil, and balsamic.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Layer mozzarella, tomato, and basil between the bread.
Brush the outside lightly with olive oil.
Toast in a panini press or skillet until crisp and the cheese softens.
Drizzle with balsamic glaze and slice.

name: Falafel Pita
description: Crisp falafel with cucumber, tomato, greens, and tahini.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Warm the pita.
Heat falafel until crisp.
Fill each pita with lettuce, cucumber, tomato, and falafel.
Drizzle with tahini and serve.

name: Tuna Rice Bowl
description: Warm rice topped with savory tuna, cucumber, and sesame.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Mix tuna with mayonnaise and soy sauce.
Divide warm rice between bowls.
Top with tuna and cucumber.
Finish with sesame seeds.

name: Tomato Soup & Grilled Cheese
description: Creamy tomato soup paired with a crisp, cheesy sandwich.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Cook onion in olive oil until soft.
Add tomatoes and broth; simmer for 12 minutes.
Blend until smooth, then stir in cream.
Butter bread, add cheese, and toast both sides until golden.
Serve the grilled cheese with hot soup.

name: Veggie Hummus Wrap
description: Hummus and crunchy vegetables wrapped up for an easy lunch.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Spread hummus over each tortilla.
Add spinach and sliced vegetables.
Fold the sides inward and roll tightly.
Slice in half and serve.

name: Cinnamon Apple Toast
description: Toast topped with warm apple slices, cinnamon, and honey.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Toast the bread.
Cook apple slices in butter for 3 minutes.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Pile apples onto toast and drizzle with honey.

name: Spiced Popcorn
description: Fresh popcorn tossed with smoky paprika and garlic.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Pop the kernels in a covered pot over medium heat.
Melt the butter.
Toss popcorn with butter, paprika, garlic powder, and salt.
Serve immediately.

name: Guacamole & Chips
description: Fresh avocado guacamole with lime, tomato, onion, and tortilla chips.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Scoop avocado into a bowl and mash with a fork.
Stir in lime juice, onion, tomato, and cilantro.
Season with salt and taste.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips.

name: Energy Bites
description: No-bake oat and peanut butter bites for a quick homemade snack.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Stir all ingredients together in a bowl.
Chill for 20 minutes if the mixture feels sticky.
Roll into small balls with clean hands.
Refrigerate in a sealed container.

name: Cucumber Yogurt Dip
description: Cool cucumber and yogurt dip with garlic and herbs.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Squeeze excess water from the grated cucumber.
Mix cucumber, yogurt, garlic, lemon, and dill.
Season with salt.
Chill for 10 minutes and serve with vegetables or pita.

name: Honey Banana Toast
description: Crisp toast topped with banana, honey, and cinnamon.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with peanut butter if using.
Top with sliced banana.
Drizzle with honey and dust with cinnamon.

name: Mango Lassi
description: A cold, creamy mango and yogurt drink.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Add mango, yogurt, milk, honey, and cardamom to a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Add ice and blend briefly again.
Pour and serve cold.

name: Iced Matcha Latte
description: Earthy matcha shaken with milk and served over ice.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Whisk matcha with warm water until smooth.
Fill a glass with ice.
Pour in milk and honey.
Top with the matcha and stir.

name: Strawberry Lemonade
description: Fresh strawberries blended with bright lemon and cold water.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Blend strawberries with 1 cup water.
Stir the strawberry mixture with lemon juice, remaining water, and sugar.
Taste and adjust sweetness.
Serve over ice.

name: Mint Lime Cooler
description: A bright lime drink with fresh mint and sparkling water.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Muddle lime juice, mint, and sugar in a glass.
Fill the glass with ice.
Top with sparkling water.
Stir gently and garnish with mint.

name: Cold Brew Latte
description: Cold brew coffee balanced with creamy milk over ice.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Fill a glass with ice.
Pour in cold brew.
Add milk and maple syrup.
Stir and serve.

name: Peach Iced Tea
description: Black tea chilled with peach and a little sweetness.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Steep tea bags in hot water for 5 minutes.
Remove tea bags and stir in sugar.
Add cold water and peach slices.
Chill and serve over ice.

name: Chocolate Mug Cake
description: A warm single-serving chocolate cake made in a mug.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Mix flour, sugar, cocoa, and baking powder in a microwave-safe mug.
Stir in milk and oil until smooth.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Microwave for about 60 to 80 seconds; let cool briefly before eating.

name: Berry Cheesecake Cups
description: Individual cheesecake cups with berries and a crumb crust.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Beat cream cheese, yogurt, powdered sugar, and vanilla until smooth.
Divide graham crumbs between two cups.
Spoon the cheesecake mixture over the crumbs.
Top with berries and chill before serving.

name: Cinnamon Churro Bites
description: Golden dough bites tossed in cinnamon sugar.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Heat water, butter, and 1 tbsp sugar until simmering.
Stir in flour until a dough forms; cool slightly.
Mix in the egg.
Pipe small pieces into hot oil and fry until golden.
Toss warm bites with cinnamon and sugar.

name: Mango Sticky Rice
description: Sweet coconut sticky rice served with ripe mango.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Cook glutinous rice according to package directions.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt without boiling.
Stir most of the coconut mixture into warm rice and rest for 10 minutes.
Slice mango and serve with the sticky rice.
Drizzle with remaining coconut sauce and sesame seeds.

name: Lemon Shortbread
description: Buttery shortbread with fresh lemon zest.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Heat oven to 350°F.
Cream butter and sugar.
Mix in flour, lemon zest, and salt until a soft dough forms.
Press into a lined pan and score into pieces.
Bake 18 to 22 minutes until lightly golden. Cool before cutting.

name: Apple Crisp
description: Warm cinnamon apples under a crisp oat topping.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Heat oven to 375°F.
Toss apples with lemon juice, half the sugar, and cinnamon.
Mix oats, flour, remaining sugar, and butter into a crumbly topping.
Place apples in a baking dish and cover with topping.
Bake 30 minutes until bubbling and golden.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Tender chicken simmered in a tomato, yogurt, and spice sauce.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt, lemon, and half the spices for 15 minutes.
Brown chicken in oil and set aside.
Cook onion and garlic until soft; add remaining spices.
Add tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Return chicken, add cream, and simmer until chicken is cooked through.

name: Vegetable Pad Thai
description: Rice noodles tossed with vegetables, lime, and a savory pad Thai sauce.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Soak or cook noodles according to package directions.
Mix soy sauce, lime juice, and brown sugar.
Stir-fry vegetables in oil for 2 minutes.
Push vegetables aside and scramble the eggs.
Add noodles and sauce; toss until coated. Top with peanuts and sprouts.

name: Beef Bulgogi
description: Thin beef slices quickly marinated and caramelized in a savory sauce.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Mix soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, and garlic.
Toss beef and onion in the marinade for 15 minutes.
Cook beef in a very hot skillet in batches until browned.
Return everything to the pan briefly to caramelize.
Top with green onion and sesame seeds.

name: Margherita Pizza
description: Crisp pizza dough with tomato, mozzarella, basil, and olive oil.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Heat oven to its highest setting with a baking tray or stone inside.
Stretch dough into a thin round.
Spread with tomato sauce and add mozzarella.
Bake until the crust is browned and cheese is bubbling.
Finish with basil, olive oil, and a pinch of salt.

name: Salmon Teriyaki
description: Pan-seared salmon glazed with a quick homemade teriyaki sauce.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Mix soy sauce, honey, vinegar, garlic, and sesame oil.
Sear salmon skin-side down until crisp.
Flip and cook until nearly done.
Pour in the sauce and simmer until glossy and the salmon is cooked through.
Garnish with green onion.

name: Chickpea Coconut Curry
description: Chickpeas simmered in a creamy coconut tomato curry.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Cook onion in oil until soft.
Add garlic and curry powder for 30 seconds.
Stir in chickpeas and tomatoes.
Add coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in spinach if using and cook until wilted. Serve with rice.

name: Garlic Herb Chicken & Broccoli Rice
description: Chicken with broccoli and rice, finished with a garlic herb sauce.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Prep the broccoli and other ingredients.
Cook the chicken in a hot pan until fully cooked.
Add the broccoli and cook until tender-crisp.
Stir in the garlic herb ingredients and cook for 1 to 2 minutes.
Serve over the rice and season to taste.

creator: Community Cooks
steps: Toast the bread until crisp.
Whisk eggs with turmeric, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Cook onion and tomato in olive oil for 2 minutes.
Add spinach, then pour in the eggs and cook until set.
Fold the omelet and serve over the toast.

name: Poha Breakfast Bowl
description: A indian breakfast with practical ingredients and straightforward preparation.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Rinse 1 cup poha in a sieve until soft, then drain.
Heat 1 tbsp oil and toast 1/2 tsp mustard seeds until they pop.
Cook diced onion and green chili for 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the poha, turmeric, salt, and 1/4 cup peas; toss for 3 minutes.
Finish with lemon juice and cilantro.

name: Aloo Paratha
description: A indian breakfast with practical ingredients and straightforward preparation.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Boil 2 potatoes until tender, peel them, and mash them with cumin, chili powder, and salt.
Knead 1 1/2 cups flour with water into a soft dough and divide it into balls.
Roll one dough ball flat, fill it with the potato mixture, and seal it.
Roll gently into a 6-inch circle.
Cook on a hot skillet, brushing with a little oil, until golden spots appear on both sides.
Serve warm.

name: Idli Sambar Bowl
description: A indian breakfast with practical ingredients and straightforward preparation.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Warm the idlis and sambar separately.
Place the idlis in a bowl and pour the hot sambar over them.
Add coconut chutney on the side.
Garnish with cilantro and serve hot.

name: Besan Chilla
description: Savory Indian chickpea-flour pancakes with onion, tomato, cilantro, and warm spices.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Whisk the besan, water, cumin, turmeric, chili powder, and salt until you have a smooth batter.
Stir in the diced onion, tomato, and cilantro.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat and brush it with a little oil.
Pour about 1/3 cup batter into the skillet and spread it into a thin circle.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes until the bottom is golden and the edges look set.
Flip and cook for another 1 to 2 minutes. Repeat with the remaining batter and serve hot.

name: Chana Masala Rice Bowl
description: A indian lunch with practical ingredients and straightforward preparation.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil and cook diced onion until golden.
Add garlic, ginger, cumin, and garam masala and cook for 30 seconds.
Add cooked chickpeas and tomato sauce, then simmer for 8 to 10 minutes.
Season with salt and lemon juice.
Spoon the chana masala over cooked rice and serve.

name: Paneer Tikka Wrap
description: A indian lunch with practical ingredients and straightforward preparation.
creator: Community Cooks
steps: Mix paneer cubes with yogurt, cumin, paprika, garam masala, and salt.
Cook the paneer in a hot skillet until browned on several sides.
Warm the tortillas and spread them with chutney.
Add paneer, sliced onion, and cilantro.
Roll tightly and serve.

name: Rajma Rice Bowl
description: A indian lunch with practical ingredients and straightforward preparation.

steps: Cook diced onion in oil until golden.
